# Table: <tr> and <td> Tags

#### Course: Learn HTML

## Table: <tr> and <td> Tags

The <tr> tag stands for table row, and the <td> tag stands for table data.

You use <tr> inside <table> to define rows and <td> inside <tr> to define data cells within those rows. For example,

```html
1<table>
2  <tr>
3    <td>Harry</td>
4    <td>18</td>
5    <td>England</td>
6  </tr>
7
8  <tr>
9    <td>John</td>
10    <td>18</td>
11    <td>USA</td>
12  </tr>
13</table>
```

This code includes two <tr> tags directly inside the <table> tag. In other words, the table has two rows.

Each <tr> tag contains three <td> tags, i.e., each row has three data cells.
